name: Measured signature retrieval
description: Read an approved JSON file: schema_version=1.0 and signatures, a list of one to three per-line objects with context (A549, K562 or MCF7), dose_nM and genes (HGNC symbol to log-expression shift against matched vehicle), optionally centered=true when the caller already subtracted the shared response. Optional exclude_reference_compounds (names or skeleton keys) and top_k (1-20). Compares the signature with a digest-bound library of measured SciPlex3 24 h responses, centered on the library's mean response at the same line and dose, and returns the most similar reference classes and compounds, a gene-permutation null for the best similarity, and the procedure's recorded held-out agreement with the vendor annotation. Unsupported lines, too few matched genes (fewer than 200) and a missing library are refused by name.
use_when: A measured transcriptional response of a compound in A549, K562 or MCF7 is available and the question is which annotated compound classes it resembles, for example whether a response looks like its declared target class or like another class.
do_not_use_when: The signature is a model prediction rather than a measurement, comes from another cell line, time point or assay, or the question needs a mechanism verdict, target engagement, viability or a measured premise; resemblance to a class never establishes any of these.
